audit.body_sample: Topic: Campaign Rho revision — Publication Front Wave 0 residual (CR-R1) Mission: Retrieve Publication Front Wave 0 residual chain Purpose of this reading: Revision is retrieval-first. Open the CMP only at a failed locus on the Publication Front chain — not as a re-teach of all of Chapter 1–2.1. Open: CMP · only at failed Publication Front locus Stop: After closed-book retrieval of CR chain and targeted CMP reopen at failures — stop before claiming Approver clearance, until-exam trust, or spine
audit.support_sample: Keep CMP closed for first-pass retrieval. Reopen only at failed loci. Kwalitec is the guide; the CMP is authoritative. Stop when retrieval + targeted reopen are done — refuse Approver clearance, spine PASS, and until-exam claims. What did you extract from the CMP setup? Submit Answer
